test.create_query: CREATE TABLE perf_has_any_tags (id UInt64, tags Array(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1
CREATE TABLE perf_has_any_hex (id UInt64, f Array(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO perf_has_any_tags SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> concat('tag', toString(toUInt32(floor(pow(200000, (cityHash64(number, x) % 1000000) / 1000000.0))))), range(3 + number % 8)) FROM numbers(10000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1
INSERT INTO perf_has_any_hex SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> lower(hex(MD5(toString(cityHash64(number, x))))), range(3 + number % 8)) FROM numbers(2000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(id) FROM perf_has_any_tags WHERE hasAny(tags, ['tag21598', 'tag90001', 'tag31337', 'tag77777'])
